docs.title: Penalized GLM
docs.text:
Validated against R 4.6.1 glm() / MASS 7.3.65 glm.nb() / negative.binomial(theta) / quasipoisson family, and an R Newton posterior-mode fit for the Gaussian-prior (ridge/MAP) cases. Source: anofox-regression 0.5.22 tests/fixtures/penalized_glm_aft_reference.rs (tests/r_scripts/penalized_glm_aft_reference.R).

Rpolars-statistics 
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(MASS) })
glm(yp ~ x1 + x2, family = poisson)                       # log link
glm(yp ~ x1 + x2, family = poisson(link = "sqrt"))
glm(yp ~ x1 + x2 + offset(off), family = poisson)
glm(yp ~ x1 + x2 - 1, family = poisson)                   # no intercept
glm(ynb ~ x1 + x2, family = poisson)                      # overdispersed
glm(ynb ~ x1 + x2, family = quasipoisson)                 # quasipoisson
glm(yb ~ x1 + x2, family = binomial)                      # logit
glm(yb ~ x1 + x2, family = binomial(link = "probit"))
glm(yb ~ x1 + x2, family = binomial(link = "cloglog"))
glm(yb ~ x1 + x2 + offset(off), family = binomial)
glm(yg ~ x1 + x2, family = Gamma(link = "log"))
glm(yg ~ x1 + x2 + offset(off), family = Gamma(link = "log"))
glm.nb(ynb ~ x1 + x2)                                     # estimated theta
glm(ynb ~ x1 + x2, family = negative.binomial(2.5))       # fixed theta

ps.penalized_glm("y", "x1", "x2", family="poisson")
ps.penalized_glm("y", "x1", "x2", family="poisson", offset="log_exposure")
ps.penalized_glm("y", "x1", "x2", family="poisson", estimate_dispersion=True)
ps.penalized_glm("y", "x1", "x2", family="binomial", link="probit")
ps.penalized_glm("y", "x1", "x2", family="gamma")
ps.penalized_glm("y", "x1", "x2", family="negative_binomial")  # theta=None
ps.penalized_glm(
    "y", "x1", "x2", family="poisson",
    priors=[("intercept", "flat"), ("normal", 0.5, 0.5), ("normal", 0.0, 0.25)],
    vcov_type="sandwich",
)
Case Output field Tolerance Poisson log / sqrt / offset / no-intercept / overdispersed coefficients, intercept 1e-6 Every family's std_error (incl. quasipoisson, fixed-theta NegBin) std_error 1e-5 deviance, null_deviance (with offsets, without intercept), log_likelihood, aic all families 1e-7 Gamma log_likelihood (at deviance / n) log_likelihood 1e-9 Negative Binomial theta (ML-estimated) theta 1e-5 Quasipoisson dispersion dispersion 1e-7 Gaussian-prior posterior mode (Poisson, 3 priors × 3 vcov_type) coefficients (MAP) 1e-7 Gaussian-prior posterior covariance std_error (laplace / sandwich / naive) 1e-6

Binomial logit/probit/cloglog/offset and Logistic are validated the same way as the Binomial/Logistic rows in Binomial GLM and Intercept Inference and Probit Precision above, applied to ps.penalized_glm's Binomial/Logistic families. Tweedie's p=1 (Poisson) and p=2 (Gamma) special cases are checked against the Poisson/Gamma identities above (the log-likelihood/deviance formulas coincide exactly at those two variance powers). Source test file: tests/test_penalized_glm.py.

docs.title: AFT Survival Regression
docs.text:
Validated against R survival 3.8.6 survreg() across all four supported distributions. Source: anofox-regression 0.5.22 tests/fixtures/penalized_glm_aft_reference.rs (tests/r_scripts/penalized_glm_aft_reference.R; the same time/ev right-censored dataset for all four fits).

Rpolars-statistics 
library(survival)
survreg(Surv(time, ev) ~ x1 + x2, dist = "weibull")
survreg(Surv(time, ev) ~ x1 + x2, dist = "lognormal")
survreg(Surv(time, ev) ~ x1 + x2, dist = "loglogistic")
survreg(Surv(time, ev) ~ x1 + x2, dist = "exponential")
predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x1 = 0.3, x2 = -0.2),
        type = "quantile", p = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.9))

ps.aft("time", "event", "x1", "x2", distribution="weibull")
ps.aft("time", "event", "x1", "x2", distribution="lognormal")
ps.aft("time", "event", "x1", "x2", distribution="loglogistic")
ps.aft("time", "event", "x1", "x2", distribution="exponential")
ps.aft_predict_quantile("time", "event", "x1", "x2", p=[0.25, 0.5, 0.9])
Output field Tolerance coefficients, scale 1e-6 log_likelihood (m$loglik) 1e-7 std_error incl. log(scale) SE (sqrt(diag(vcov(m)))) 1e-5 predict_quantile at p = 0.25, 0.5, 0.9 1e-6 S(quantile(p)) == 1 - p identity 1e-9

The log_scale row's statistic/p_value/CI (absent for exponential, which has no free scale parameter) are computed locally via upstream's own laplace::inference Wald formula; the intercept and feature rows are read directly from upstream's AftInference, never recomputed — the two are confirmed identical on upstream's own module-doc example. Right censoring is via an explicit event column (0/1 or boolean); any other coding (e.g. R's 1/2) is rejected rather than silently misread. Source test file: tests/test_aft.py.
